title: Number-Call Eyes-Up Dribble
description: Players dribble while the coach flashes fingers; they shout the number, building the habit of dribbling with the head up.

content.objective: Dribble with control while reading information from the coach, so the eyes are free to see the floor in games.
content.setup: Players face the coach in scattered spots with a ball each.
content.organization: Whole group. The coach stands where everyone can see one raised hand.
instructions: Players start a control dribble at waist height.
The coach raises a hand showing one to five fingers.
Players shout the number as soon as they see it, without stopping the dribble.
Every 20 seconds the coach calls 'switch' and players change hands.
Finish with a round where the number tells them which move to make (1 crossover, 2 between the legs).
coachingPoints: Chin up: see the coach's whole body, not just the hand.
Keep the ball on the side, away from the knees.
Answer loudly; a quiet answer usually means a late look.
commonMistakes: Peeking at the ball before answering.
Dribbling too high and losing control while looking up.
Stopping the dribble to call the number.
content.safety: Keep a clear space around each player; stop the round if balls start rolling into others.
progressions: Flash numbers with both hands and ask for the total.
Add a move per number to make it a decision drill.
regressions: Allow a two-hand catch after each number for beginners.
variations: Use colours on cards instead of fingers.
successCriteria: Calls the correct number within one second, eight times in a row.
No lost balls in a 30-second round.
content.gameApplication: A player who dribbles with the head up sees the open cutter and the help defender before it is too late.
